title: GAX-P08 - Native licensed abstention benchmark and pre-results protocol replacement
outcome: Replace blocked paper-required abstention/runtime dependencies with reproducible pre-results benchmark and protocol decisions while preserving sealed final-test access.
rationale: SG-000017 proved that MedQAbstain is reproducibly identifiable but not licensed clearly enough for paper-required use. SG-000016 separately proved the MedAgentBench public corpus while leaving its official runtime/scorer blocked. These blockers must be resolved by an explicit pre-results protocol decision, never by dropping hard cases after seeing model performance.
scope_in: GAX-native evidence-availability insufficiency pairs derived from the already-qualified PubMedQA PQA-L source
Separate information-sufficiency supervision from the closed action distribution
Deterministic pair lineage and role-manifest digests
Independent qualification of optional external abstention sources only when immutable identity and source-content rights are established
Pre-results reclassification of blocked MedQAbstain and MedAgentBench official runtime requirements
Pre-results required-versus-optional baseline policy based only on reproducibility and zero-founder-cost compute
Calibration, coverage, hardware, multiplicity, ECAL-selection, and FHIR-representation protocol freeze
scope_out: No GAX or baseline final-test inference
No final-test threshold, checkpoint, prompt, ECAL, or representation selection
No conversion of abstain into an ordinary candidate action
No claim that missing benchmark evidence proves generic clinical insufficiency
No clinical-safety, deployment, superiority, or SOTA claim
acceptance: Canonical dependency is SG-000017 closeout main a97bd6b637be2d98ef98758749edf5f197cc97f8
The required native abstention source reuses the already-qualified PubMedQA PQA-L identity rather than inventing a new mutable source
For evidence-present development/calibration items, Gold.sufficient is true and the original typed action supervision is preserved
For evidence-withheld development/calibration items, Gold.sufficient is false while Gold.action is null; abstain is not inserted into BenchmarkItem.actions
Evidence-withheld pairs preserve the same state, allowed actions, source identity, split, and deterministic pair lineage while removing model-visible evidence
Final-test pair construction never serializes action or sufficiency supervision while P08 access is sealed
No test-derived teacher data, threshold selection, prompt selection, checkpoint selection, ECAL selection, or FHIR representation selection occurs
The benchmark is described narrowly as evidence-availability insufficiency/selective-decision evaluation and not as generic clinical safety
Any external source is admitted only after immutable revision, license/source-content provenance, redistribution, split, and leakage evidence are frozen
MedQAbstain remains reported as a blocked external benchmark rather than silently removed
MedAgentBench public corpus/runtime distinction remains visible even if the blocked official runtime becomes optional for authorization
Required heavyweight baselines are reclassified only from pre-results reproducibility and zero-founder-cost evidence, never observed performance
Overall P08 final-test access remains sealed throughout SG-000018
Exact-head Linux/Windows Python 3.11/3.12 CI and dedicated native-abstention qualification pass before merge
Implementation merges with expected_head_sha and post-main qualification succeeds
A separate canonical closeout is required before SG-000018 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000018 and retain MedQAbstain/MedAgentBench blockers. Final-test access remains sealed and no model result is generated in this grain.
